candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and resolves them into one binding policy_capsule carrying a complete executable policy artifact. The final call consumes only that capsule, has no common-input visibility or policy-revision authority, and emits the contained artifact as the single policy.
candidate_structure.name: Single-Contact Authority Inversion
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with intake-localized binding policy authority and artifact-only terminal emission

calls.objective: Resolve the supplied hypothesis against all six visible sources and bind one complete executable policy artifact with settled evidence commitments into a single policy capsule.

Consume bind_executable_authority as the sole visible evidence, preserve its complete executable artifact and settled commitments without reinterpretation or alternate construction, and emit that artifact as the one policy.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: terminal lossless evidence reacquisition paired with undivided terminal policy authority
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: single-contact executable commitment: the only call with raw-source visibility binds the complete policy artifact, and its descendant may only expose that artifact without reinterpretation
rejected_assumptions: Policy-forming authority must be reserved for a terminal call that reacquires every source.
A nonbinding analysis handoff adequately preserves decisions required for executable materialization.
Reopening inherited anchor evidence at emission improves reconciliation rather than recapturing inherited framing.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Invert authority across the sole handoff: the first fully informed call binds one complete executable policy capsule, while the terminal call receives only that capsule and has non-revising emission authority.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Resolving evidence once at intake should preserve counter-hypothesis commitments, reduce terminal anchor recapture, and maintain executable continuity through emission.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion delays executable commitment until a terminal authority that reopens every source, allowing settled counter-evidence to be reinterpreted through inherited framing.

structural_mutation.after: A binding complete executable policy capsule crosses the handoff, consuming the lineage's raw-evidence authority so the terminal call sees only the capsule and cannot reopen policy decisions.
structural_mutation.before: A nonbinding analysis crosses the handoff, after which a terminal call reacquires all common inputs and holds undivided policy-forming authority.
structural_mutation.factor: binding executable authority inversion across the sole handoff
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation reverses where policy authority resides and consequently changes edge payload semantics, evidence timing, terminal visibility, and state-transition authority rather than renaming or splitting roles.

validation.factor: binding executable authority inversion across the sole handoff

policy_bearing_output_kinds.executor_semantics: complete policy artifact plus obligation evidence on the same single lineage
